decisions_this_run: The roster excludes only the terminal DEPROVISIONED state, not everything that is not ACTIVE. `== ACTIVE` also hides SUSPENDED / INVITED / PENDING, which are all states an administrator can restore, and the roster is the only list that hands them the membership id to act on.

The filter belongs in the repository, not the router, because the router derives PageMeta(total=len(items)) from the repository's return value. A router-side filter would fix the rows and leave the count wrong -- half a fix for a defect whose second half was the count.
Offboarding stays a soft delete. Hard-deleting the membership would destroy who-was-a-member history, which is what DEPROVISIONED exists to retain.

Verified the guard test rather than assuming it: replacing the predicate with `== ACTIVE` turns test_a_suspended_member_stays_in_the_roster red (1 failed / 2 passed). The first draft of the run's notes claimed the opposite; it was corrected against the real fixture before committing.
